{{Quote|The reason we forced that freighter to land on Korasa was because I needed a handful of ''moon dust''&hellip; the ''only thing'' that can deactivate the blade's ''cloaking shield''!|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
'''Moon dust''' was a powdery substance that could be found on [[Korasa]], in the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]]. It had the unique particularity of deactivating [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking shields]]. Because of its power, the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used it during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when he [[Korasa job|raided]] a [[Jedi Research Facility]] in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], in hopes of stealing the [[Blade of Beginnings]], which was kept under a cloaking shield.
